For a 1,000Wh (1kWh) power station, I recommend 200–300W of solar panels for practical everyday recharging. If you want a full recharge in one good summer day, aim for around 300W or more.

The sizing guides agree that a 200W panel is a reasonable starting point, while approximately 300W is a better target for a one-day summer recharge. Sources: Watt48, Power Preflight, and Held in Reserve.
